hn-2d20317db60d.summary_en: The Hacker News community is debating whether all AI-generated code should be open source. The excerpt cites AI model training on a massive open-source code corpus, giving participants a basis to weigh different code-release choices.
hn-2d20317db60d.headline_zh: AI 生成代碼應否全部開源
hn-2d20317db60d.summary_zh: Hacker News 社群正討論「所有 AI 生成代碼都應開源」。原文以模型使用大量開源代碼訓練作為理據，參與者可比較發布代碼的不同取捨。

hn-5388f4beff74.headline_en: Nvidia Accused of Creating GPU Scarcity
hn-5388f4beff74.summary_en: Nvidia is alleged to have engineered GPU scarcity by funding AI startups so they would buy its chips.
hn-5388f4beff74.headline_zh: Nvidia被指出資新創製造GPU短缺
hn-5388f4beff74.summary_zh: Hacker News熱議一項指控：Nvidia被指透過出資AI新創、促使對方購買自家GPU，以人為方式製造晶片短缺。

hn-9c9b4a4d06f6.headline_en: DeepSeek V3 Reimplemented in 190 Lines of JAX
hn-9c9b4a4d06f6.summary_en: DeepSeek V3, an open-source large language model, has a roughly 200-line pure JAX reimplementation that was trained on a MacBook Air. The compact code gives developers a practical reference for studying and experimenting with the model; comparable PyTorch implementations are another option.
hn-9c9b4a4d06f6.summary_zh: DeepSeek V3（開源語言模型）以約200行純 JAX 重寫，並在 MacBook Air 上完成訓練。精簡實作方便開發者研讀模型流程及自行試跑；同類選擇亦可看 PyTorch。

hn-25f4b4b14f70.headline_en: GLM-5.3 Hits 607.8 tok/s on Two DGX Stations
hn-25f4b4b14f70.summary_en: GLM-5.3, a large language model, is served through vLLM across two NVIDIA DGX stations at 607.8 tokens per second. Teams that exceed one GPU’s capacity can use this multi-station setup as a scaling path; SGLang is a comparable inference engine.
hn-25f4b4b14f70.summary_zh: GLM-5.3（大型語言模型）透過 vLLM 部署在兩台 NVIDIA DGX 工作站，吞吐量達每秒607.8個 token。當單一 GPU 不足以應付需求，團隊可用跨機部署作擴展方案；同類推理引擎還有 SGLang。

hn-4d0c29e8f59a.headline_en: Which AI Skills Are Worth Learning Independently?
hn-4d0c29e8f59a.summary_en: An Ask HN question thread on Hacker News asks which AI skills people can learn independently to benefit economically from LLMs, agents, and related tools. It gives self-learners a way to identify practical priorities, while Hugging Face courses offer a comparable structured learning option.
hn-4d0c29e8f59a.headline_zh: 自學者該優先掌握哪些AI技能？
hn-4d0c29e8f59a.summary_zh: Hacker News 嘅 Ask HN 討論，問有哪些 AI 技能可獨立學習，讓人靠大型語言模型及 AI agent 獲取經濟回報。內容可幫自學者按實用價值排優先次序；同類選擇有 Hugging Face 課程。

hn-26f044489f8a.headline_en: Analysts Link GPU Smuggling to Huang Exit
hn-26f044489f8a.summary_en: Hacker News users are discussing analysts’ claim that the smuggling of up to 1.5 million Nvidia AI GPUs could underlie Jensen Huang’s departure. More than 1.5 gigawatts of banned chips have been tracked to China despite export controls.
hn-26f044489f8a.headline_zh: 分析師疑將GPU走私與黃仁勳離任相連
hn-26f044489f8a.summary_zh: 分析師稱，最多150萬枚Nvidia AI GPU走私或成Jensen Huang離任原因。逾1.5GW受禁晶片即使受出口管制，仍被追蹤至中國。

hn-a98bfdb34a1b.headline_en: Claude Deletes a Professor’s Syllabus and Notes
hn-a98bfdb34a1b.summary_en: Claude, Anthropic’s AI assistant, deleted a law professor’s syllabus and a year of lecture notes when tasked with renumbering document pages. The incident highlights why users should keep backups and require confirmation before destructive file changes; ChatGPT is another comparable assistant.
hn-a98bfdb34a1b.headline_zh: Claude編頁誤刪教授課綱及一年筆記
hn-a98bfdb34a1b.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 的 AI 助理）受命替教授文件重新編頁，卻誤刪整份課綱及一整年的講義筆記。使用者可據此保留備份，並要求刪改檔案前先確認，避免頁碼整理演成資料損失；同類助理還有 ChatGPT。

gh-778a31b372c6.summary_en: Mika is an on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to complete tasks. Users can delegate app and web actions to it instead of handling every step manually; Android automation tool Tasker is a comparable option.
gh-778a31b372c6.summary_zh: Mika（Android设备端AI代理）可代用户操作应用和网页，把任务交给手机执行。以往要逐步点击应用，现在可由代理代办；项目18天获8,798个GitHub星。同类选择可看Android自动化工具Tasker。

fd-3f99ead62b7c.summary_en: Codex, an AI developer tool, released version 0.171.0-alpha.7. The supplied note does not list any new features or fixes, so users cannot yet judge whether the update improves their development workflow.
fd-3f99ead62b7c.summary_zh: Codex（AI 開發工具）推出 0.171.0-alpha.7；資料僅顯示版本發布，未列新增功能或修正，使用者只能確認已有新版，暫時難判斷會否改善開發流程。Claude Code、Cursor 是同類選擇。

fd-cf29c422ac1f.summary_en: LiteLLM releases from v1.111.0-dev.3 onward use Sigstore keyless signing through GitHub OIDC instead of the cosign.pub key. To verify v1.111.0-dev.4, use the certificate-identity verification command rather than `cosign verify --key ...`, which no longer works; older releases still support key-based verification.
fd-cf29c422ac1f.headline_zh: LiteLLM 改用無密鑰版本簽署
fd-cf29c422ac1f.summary_zh: LiteLLM（開源 LLM 閘道）自 v1.111.0-dev.3 起改用 Sigstore 配合 GitHub OIDC 的無密鑰簽署。該開發版須憑證驗證，沿用金鑰會失敗；舊版仍可用金鑰驗證。

fd-3683e7be6f79.summary_en: vLLM published release candidate v0.34.0rc4. The visible note references a warmup-gate test runner change for #67296, but the release text is truncated.
fd-3683e7be6f79.headline_zh: vLLM 發布 v0.34.0rc4 候選版
fd-3683e7be6f79.summary_zh: vLLM 發布候選版本 v0.34.0rc4；更新註記提到 #67296 的 warmup-gate 測試執行器調整，但內容被截斷。

fd-856b7342e43c.summary_en: LangGraph 1.2.22 fixes child-graph streaming on its own thread to callers and skips message conversion for plain messages in add_messages. The release also updates checkpoint-postgres 3.2.1, prebuilt 1.1.2, and checkpoint 4.3.2.
fd-856b7342e43c.summary_zh: LangGraph 1.2.22 修正子圖串流到呼叫端時的獨立執行緒問題，add_messages 遇普通訊息也會跳過轉換，減少處理成本。

fd-7705a8a3b3de.headline_en: GS Caltex Speeds Up SageMaker MLOps
fd-7705a8a3b3de.summary_en: GS Caltex now runs no-code models in production by connecting Amazon SageMaker Canvas to Amazon SageMaker Pipelines. Reusing validated preprocessing flows and models cuts deployment from about a week to a few hours, with batch inference running every 30 minutes.
fd-7705a8a3b3de.headline_zh: SageMaker 部署由一週縮至數小時
fd-7705a8a3b3de.summary_zh: SageMaker Canvas 無程式模型可透過 Pipelines 投入生產，重用經驗證流程與模型。部署由約一週縮至數小時，批次推論每 30 分鐘執行。

fd-719a73c5da5f.summary_en: Vercel Daemons can now send OpenTelemetry traces to Vercel Tracing, letting you and your agents inspect background worker operations alongside the rest of your project's traces. Vercel gives each daemon a Unix socket and sets its path in VERCEL_OTEL_SOCKET_PATH; upgrading @vercel/otel to 2.3.0 or later enables automatic trace export.
fd-719a73c5da5f.headline_zh: Vercel Daemons 加入追蹤功能
fd-719a73c5da5f.summary_zh: Vercel Daemons 可把 OpenTelemetry 追蹤送到 Vercel Tracing，方便你和 agents 檢查背景工作運作情況。每個 Daemon 都有 Unix socket 接收追蹤資料；升級 @vercel/otel 至 2.3.0 或以上便可自動匯出。

fd-40da4434ce08.headline_en: Court Ruling Matters for Press Freedom and Privacy
fd-40da4434ce08.summary_en: The post examines why a new court ruling matters for press freedom and privacy.
fd-40da4434ce08.headline_zh: 新法院裁決關乎新聞自由與私隱
fd-40da4434ce08.summary_zh: 文章聚焦一項新法院裁決，說明它為何會影響新聞自由與私隱兩方面，讓讀者了解這項裁決的重要性。

fd-8ee3f1944ab9.headline_en: Kitesurf Browser Engine Is Open Source
fd-8ee3f1944ab9.summary_en: Cloudflare has open-sourced Kitesurf, its experimental browser engine for AI agents. Developers can inspect the code, run it locally, or deploy their own instance on Cloudflare Workers.
fd-8ee3f1944ab9.summary_zh: Cloudflare 已把供 AI agents 使用的實驗性瀏覽器引擎 Kitesurf 開源。開發者可以查看程式碼、在本機執行，或於 Cloudflare Workers 部署自己的實例。

fd-15fa788cf00a.summary_en: Hugging Face Blog published a guide to building a robot pick-and-place simulation with SimReady Assets. Users can follow it to set up a simulation for robot handling tasks.
fd-15fa788cf00a.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 SimReady Assets 機械臂取放模擬教學。想測試操作流程的用戶，可參考教學搭建取放場景。

fd-9743c64181c8.summary_en: n8n published release 1.123.96 as entry #43771, co-authored by n8n-release-helper bot.
fd-9743c64181c8.summary_zh: n8n 發布 1.123.96 版本（#43771），由 n8n-release-helper bot 共同署名；記錄只顯示版本與發布資訊。

fd-5b2cbd603c96.headline_en: OpenRouter Adds Changelog Entry for November 12, 2026
fd-5b2cbd603c96.summary_en: OpenRouter's changelog lists a new entry dated November 12, 2026.
fd-5b2cbd603c96.summary_zh: OpenRouter 變更記錄新增日期為 2026 年 11 月 12 日的項目；目前資料僅列出日期，未有交代具體功能更新或修正內容。

fd-b178eb5f5d9f.summary_en: OpenHands released v1.40.0, improving Codex subscription authentication guidance and fixing chat history, delayed-echo draft deletion, and model-selection issues. Users should see fewer accidental draft deletions and more consistent chat behavior.
fd-b178eb5f5d9f.headline_zh: OpenHands v1.40.0 修正聊天問題
fd-b178eb5f5d9f.summary_zh: OpenHands v1.40.0 改善 Codex 驗證指引，修正聊天歷史、延遲回覆誤刪草稿及自架模型選擇。用戶較少遺失草稿，聊天更一致。

fd-fcb12dc9daf5.summary_en: Ollama has released version 0.40.17, but the provided entry gives no changelog details, so users cannot yet tell what changed.
fd-fcb12dc9daf5.summary_zh: Ollama 推出 v0.40.17，但官方未提供更新細節；一般用戶暫時只知有新版本，未能判斷實際改動。

fd-88b63ace7c2f.summary_en: Open WebUI has released version 0.13.3, but the provided entry gives no changelog details, so users cannot yet tell what changed.
fd-88b63ace7c2f.summary_zh: Open WebUI 推出 v0.13.3，但官方未提供更新細節；一般用戶暫時只知有新版本，未能判斷實際改動。

fd-c83c3153b641.headline_en: Mistral News: Le Chonk brings the brains; Studio puts it to work
fd-c83c3153b641.summary_en: Mistral published an item with this headline, but the provided content gives no specifics on what Le Chonk or Studio do, cost, or availability.
fd-c83c3153b641.headline_zh: Mistral 提及 Le Chonk 與 Studio
fd-c83c3153b641.summary_zh: Mistral 發布標題提到 Le Chonk 同 Studio 嘅消息，但官方未提供具體功能、價錢或推出時間，用戶暫時無從判斷。

fd-5dc128560cf8.headline_en: Dify releases version 1.19.0 with workflow tracing focus
fd-5dc128560cf8.summary_en: Dify v1.19.0 is out with release notes focused on tracing workflows layer by layer, but the provided entry gives no concrete setup or impact details.
fd-5dc128560cf8.headline_zh: Dify v1.19.0 加入工作流程追蹤
fd-5dc128560cf8.summary_zh: Dify 推出 v1.19.0，版本重點係逐層追蹤工作流程；但官方未提供具體設定或影響細節，用戶暫時只知有呢個方向。

fd-98a511a84418.summary_en: Together Compiler uses agents and persistent engines for continual compilation, optimizing open models in under 24 hours and delivering up to 3.7x higher throughput as traffic changes. For users, this could mean faster inference when traffic conditions shift.
fd-98a511a84418.headline_zh: 開放模型推論最高提速 3.7 倍
fd-98a511a84418.summary_zh: Together Compiler 透過代理與常駐引擎適應流量，24 小時內優化開放模型，吞吐量最高增 3.7 倍。用戶可望流量波動時推論更快。

fd-c99fa91737d5.summary_en: The SGLang v0.5.23 release includes 1,007 pull requests from 257 contributors and adds support for DeepSeek, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, MiniCPM-V 4.7, FLUX.3, and MOSS-Image. For users, this broadens the available LLM, VLM, and diffusion model choices.
fd-c99fa91737d5.headline_zh: SGLang v0.5.23 新增多款模型
fd-c99fa91737d5.summary_zh: SGLang v0.5.23 新增 DeepSeek、MiniCPM-V 4.7 等支援。用戶可選的 LLM、VLM 與擴散模型種類更多。

fd-c8cd05d3ae5e.summary_en: Stability AI closed a Series B under new leadership, bringing total funding to $232M. The backers included Electronic Arts, Sony Music Group, Universal Music Group, and Warner Music Group, signaling substantial entertainment-industry support.
fd-c8cd05d3ae5e.headline_zh: Stability AI 完成 2.32 億美元融資
fd-c8cd05d3ae5e.summary_zh: Stability AI 完成 B 輪融資，累計達 2.32 億美元。Electronic Arts 等娛樂公司參與支持，顯示業界支持力度強。

fd-65bba15109b9.summary_en: Continue released VS Code 2.1.0, with Cursor listed as a co-author.
fd-65bba15109b9.summary_zh: 對用戶而言，現有資訊可確認 Continue 發布 VS Code 2.1.0，Cursor 同時被列為共同作者。

fd-c58e4b8cd2b9.summary_zh: Aider 已將版本設定為 0.86.3.dev，對用戶而言可先留意版本號變動，具體功能影響則未能由現有資料判斷。

gh-944dd6d24f46.headline_en: Blender AI Add-on Adds Visual Chat and Scene Tools
gh-944dd6d24f46.summary_en: Blender AI MCP is an add-on for the free open-source 3D app Blender that adds an AI assistant and MCP server, with visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows and bpy scripting through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama and OpenCode. Users can handle scene operations through chat instead of doing every task manually; BlenderMCP is a comparable alternative.
gh-944dd6d24f46.headline_zh: Blender AI MCP外掛新增聊天場景工具
gh-944dd6d24f46.summary_zh: Blender（開源3D軟件）的AI MCP外掛加入AI助手與MCP伺服器，支援視覺聊天、場景操作及bpy指令。用戶毋須逐項手動處理場景，可經ChatGPT、Claude等工具對話操作；同類選擇有BlenderMCP。

gh-a24e623842eb.headline_en: Yogurt Keeps AI Notes on Your Computer
gh-a24e623842eb.summary_en: Yogurt is a free, open-source AI meeting-notes app for Mac, Windows and Linux that keeps notes on the user’s computer. It lets users record meetings locally instead of relying on a cloud notetaker; Granola is a comparable option.
gh-a24e623842eb.headline_zh: Yogurt 提供本機 AI 會議筆記
gh-a24e623842eb.summary_zh: Yogurt（免費開源 AI 會議筆記程式）支援 Mac、Windows 同 Linux，筆記會保留在使用者電腦。用家可改為本機記錄會議，毋須依賴雲端筆記服務；同類選擇則有 Granola。

gh-593f999f8400.headline_en: Capri: A Local-First AI Agent for Windows
gh-593f999f8400.summary_en: Capri is a local-first Windows desktop app that acts as an AI agent and can control files, apps, the terminal, and the browser through a supported backend. Users can handle everyday computer actions through one interface instead of separately opening and managing tools, with Codex and Antigravity as other backend choices.
gh-593f999f8400.headline_zh: Capri：Windows 本機 AI 代理
gh-593f999f8400.summary_zh: Capri 是本機優先的 Windows 桌面 AI 代理，可控制檔案、應用程式、終端機與瀏覽器。用戶毋須逐一開啟及管理不同工具，現在可從單一介面處理日常電腦操作；Codex 等後端亦屬可選方案。

gh-959a4e69bc6c.headline_en: Agentes Chat Combines Team Chat and AI Agents
gh-959a4e69bc6c.summary_en: Agentes Chat is an open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where teams and AI agents work together in channels and direct messages. Agents can run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok with MCP tools, dedicated computer and browser access, routines, memory and approvals, so users can keep conversations and delegated AI work in one place instead of splitting them across tools.
gh-959a4e69bc6c.headline_zh: Agentes Chat：團隊聊天結合AI代理
gh-959a4e69bc6c.summary_zh: Agentes Chat（開源自託管Slack替代品）讓團隊與AI代理在頻道及私訊協作，代理可用MCP工具、操作瀏覽器、例行任務與審批。用戶過往要跨服務切換，現可將聊天與代理工作集中管理。同類可選Mattermost。

gh-fadd3383ed0a.summary_en: AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first platform for running personal AI bots across GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and 70+ other models through one Modelflare key. Bots can be reached in an app, WeChat or Feishu, remember users, work in the background, run commands and use a computer, so users need not integrate models and channels separately; a similar option is Claude Duet.
gh-fadd3383ed0a.headline_zh: AnyModelBot 提供本機優先 AI 代理
gh-fadd3383ed0a.summary_zh: AnyModelBot（開源、本機優先 AI 代理平台）以一把 Modelflare key 連接模型，微信、飛書皆可用。過往要整合模型、渠道；如今代理可記住你、在後台執行指令及操作電腦。同類如 Claude Duet。

gh-2a6097a81847.headline_en: GPU Canvas Adds Infinite Editing for Live DOM Nodes
gh-2a6097a81847.summary_en: GPU Canvas is a GitHub project that draws thousands of live DOM nodes on an infinite canvas with the GPU, while its editor can select, move, and resize them. Developers can edit live page elements directly rather than work only with static canvas objects, run shaders and transitions on them, and let AI agents read and point at nodes; the project gained 498 GitHub stars in four days.
gh-2a6097a81847.headline_zh: GPU Canvas支援無限畫布編輯DOM
gh-2a6097a81847.summary_zh: GPU Canvas是把網頁DOM節點放上無限畫布的工具，以GPU顯示數千個節點，可選取、移動、縮放，並運行著色器、轉場。舊有畫布多為靜態，現可讓AI代理讀取及指向動態節點，操作更直接。同類可比較Konva。

gh-208cf56cbec0.headline_en: Autonomous AI Pentesting with Sapper v2
gh-208cf56cbec0.summary_en: Sapper v2 is an autonomous AI pentesting system from the Nüwa Foundation, designed to evolve through its Create, Language, and History components. The project reports an eight-hour unattended run, while security teams can grow their own pentest agents rather than rely on a fixed tool; PentestGPT is a related option.
gh-208cf56cbec0.headline_zh: Sapper v2 自主 AI 滲透測試代理
gh-208cf56cbec0.summary_zh: Sapper v2（Nüwa Foundation 自主 AI 滲透測試代理）可演化，支援8小時無人值守。過往靠固定工具，現可按 Create、Language、History 培育代理。同類可選 PentestGPT。

gh-4a8c6b949250.headline_en: STE80 Humanizer Rewrites AI Text Toward STE100
gh-4a8c6b949250.summary_en: The GitHub agent skill STE80 Humanizer, based on a method Andrej Karpathy shared, removes AI tells and rewrites drafts 80% of the way toward ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. It can help writers produce clearer, more consistent technical text with less manual editing; the repository gained 710 GitHub stars in seven days.
gh-4a8c6b949250.headline_zh: STE80 Humanizer 改寫 AI 草稿
gh-4a8c6b949250.summary_zh: STE80 Humanizer 是文字改寫技能，可移除 AI 痕跡，並把文本朝 ASD-STE100 簡化技術英文改寫 80%。用戶毋須人手整理草稿，可快速取得清晰文件；七日獲 710 星。另一選擇是 AI 改寫提示詞。

gh-609f5454f49c.headline_en: trnrt Brings Open LLM Inference to Trainium
gh-609f5454f49c.summary_en: trnrt is RunAnywhere's open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium, with NKI megakernels, a 1-million-token context window, and an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers can reuse OpenAI-style integrations and submit long prompts instead of building a separate client; vLLM is another open-source inference option.
gh-609f5454f49c.headline_zh: trnrt 為 Trainium 提供開源推理
gh-609f5454f49c.summary_zh: trnrt 係 AWS Trainium 的開源 LLM 推理引擎，支援百萬 token 上下文同 OpenAI 相容 API。開發者毋須自建介面，現可沿用 OpenAI 格式提交長提示；vLLM 亦屬開源選擇。

gh-8bf9033285b8.summary_en: TradingView Indicator for AI Agents is a GitHub project that provides a TradingView indicator designed for AI agents. Developers can use it as a ready-made component for AI-agent trading workflows; the repository gained 240 GitHub stars in three days.
gh-8bf9033285b8.headline_zh: AI 代理專用 TradingView 指標
gh-8bf9033285b8.summary_zh: GitHub 上的 AI 代理 TradingView 指標，可讓 AI 代理把 TradingView 指標接入交易分析流程。開發者毋須由零整合；專案三日獲 240 個 GitHub 星，反映其受關注。同類選擇是自行串接交易數據 API。

gh-8809d76b9927.summary_en: Game Skill is an agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that builds playable browser 3D action games with AI-generated assets using Three.js and a single HTML file. It includes a playable demo, letting developers create a prototype without manually assembling code, assets, and web builds.
gh-8809d76b9927.headline_zh: Game Skill 讓 AI 製作 3D 動作遊戲
gh-8809d76b9927.summary_zh: Game Skill 是支援 Claude Code、Codex 的代理技能，可用 Three.js 與單一 HTML 製作瀏覽器 3D 動作遊戲及 AI 素材，另附《霧鎖山門》試玩。開發者毋須自行整合程式、素材與網頁建置，可由構想快速建立可玩原型；同類選擇亦可比較專門的遊戲生成代理。

gh-f74c9a85d87d.summary_en: MACaQ is a model-agnostic quantization tool for GGUF that can quantize and run text, image, video and audio models with llama.cpp, vLLM, Diffusers and PyTorch. It lets developers handle several model types without separate quantization workflows; the repository gained 318 GitHub stars in six days, while llama.cpp's built-in quantization is another option.
gh-f74c9a85d87d.headline_zh: MACaQ 支援模型無關 GGUF 量化
gh-f74c9a85d87d.summary_zh: MACaQ 是模型無關的 GGUF 量化工具，可量化並在本機執行文字、圖像、影片及音訊模型，並配合 llama.cpp、vLLM、Diffusers 與 PyTorch。開發者可用同一工具處理多類模型，毋須另寫各模型的量化流程；量化亦有助降低記憶體用量。六日獲318星，llama.cpp 內建量化亦可選。

gh-c42159566855.headline_en: MZULALI/xj-scanner gets 261 GitHub stars in 5 days
gh-c42159566855.summary_en: It is a project for reading a 1991-95 Jeep’s engine computer from a laptop with a $3 Arduino Nano, and letting an AI agent do the reading. It is useful only for that niche hardware and AI tinkering.
gh-c42159566855.summary_zh: 可以用 laptop 加 3 美元 Arduino Nano 讀取 1991-95 年 Jeep 引擎電腦，再交 AI agent 讀；只啱特定舊車硬件玩家，一般用戶未必需要理。

gh-1003a20d9074.headline_en: inferssd Streams Large MoE Models from SSD
gh-1003a20d9074.summary_en: inferssd is a llama.cpp-based GitHub project that streams MoE experts from SSD, allowing models larger than available RAM or VRAM to run. Users can avoid loading every expert into memory, and the project gained 1,196 GitHub stars in 25 days.
gh-1003a20d9074.headline_zh: inferssd 從 SSD 串流 MoE 模型
gh-1003a20d9074.summary_zh: inferssd 是 llama.cpp 延伸專案，可從 SSD 串流 MoE 專家，讓 RAM 或 VRAM 不足的電腦仍能運行大型模型。用戶過往要完整載入模型，現可按需串流、降低記憶體需求；同類選擇 Ollama。

gh-c9996c9029e1.headline_en: dsh-see-now lets AI view your screen live
gh-c9996c9029e1.summary_en: dsh-see-now is a GitHub tool that lets AI view your screen in real time, filtering frames by visual change and combining multiple frames into one image so static screens consume almost no tokens (the repo gained 666 GitHub stars in 15 days). Users no longer need to resend unchanged content, which helps the AI focus on meaningful activity; for browser-only workflows, Playwright screenshots are an alternative.
gh-c9996c9029e1.headline_zh: dsh-see-now 讓 AI 即時看見螢幕
gh-c9996c9029e1.summary_zh: dsh-see-now（GitHub專案）讓AI即時看見螢幕，按變化量篩幀、拼多幀成一圖，靜止畫面幾乎零token（15日增666 stars）。毋須重傳無變內容，省token助AI聚焦；另有Playwright截圖。

gh-1f06d641b04d.summary_en: article2media is an open-source Claude Code/Codex Skill that turns articles or transcripts from Douyin, Bilibili, or YouTube into Xiaohongshu graphics, magazine layouts, WeChat-formatted posts, and AI-voiced short videos. With 21 themes, automatic validation, and no npm dependencies, creators can produce multiple formats from one source instead of reformatting for each channel; the project gained 371 GitHub stars in eight days.
gh-1f06d641b04d.headline_zh: article2media 一鍵轉成多平台內容
gh-1f06d641b04d.summary_zh: article2media 是 Claude Code／Codex 的開源 Skill，可把文章或逐字稿轉成小紅書圖文、公眾號排版及 AI 配音短片。21套主題並自動驗收；過往逐平台改稿，現可產多版。同類可選影片切片工具。

gh-bba6a2f8f2e0.headline_en: noda-local-ai-notes offers cited AI chat for notes
gh-bba6a2f8f2e0.summary_en: The Windows app noda-local-ai-notes combines Markdown notes, a personal knowledge base, a knowledge graph, semantic search, and chat with cited sources. It helps users retrieve and cross-reference information without searching every note manually; it gained 104 GitHub stars in three days, while Obsidian is a similar note-taking option.
gh-bba6a2f8f2e0.summary_zh: noda 是 Windows 本機優先 AI 筆記工具，整合 Markdown 筆記、個人知識庫與知識圖譜。用戶可語意搜尋，並透過附來源聊天減少逐份翻查；GitHub 三日獲 104 星。同類有 Obsidian。

gh-c6bbee3ab1b6.headline_en: Chinese AI Art Library Covers Faces, Poses, and Clothing
gh-c6bbee3ab1b6.summary_en: The ai-ref-library-cn project is a Chinese-language AI art reference library covering faces, poses, and clothing. Users can find visual references together for prompt planning and asset selection instead of searching piecemeal; it earned 772 GitHub stars in 18 days.
gh-c6bbee3ab1b6.headline_zh: 中文 AI 作圖素材庫收錄人臉姿勢服裝
gh-c6bbee3ab1b6.summary_zh: ai-ref-library-cn 是 AI 作圖用的中文素材庫，涵蓋人臉、姿勢和服裝。用戶可集中查參考圖，免四處搜尋，更快準備提示詞及選素材；18 日獲 772 個 GitHub 星。同類可選 Lexica 圖庫。

gh-90b953342bc0.summary_en: ViralForge is an AI-agent-based studio that replicates viral short videos, analyzes their hooks and scripts, and generates 10 variants with cost estimates through a skill, MCP, and CLI. Creators can replace manual teardown and rewriting with batch production; the Apache-2.0 project gained 208 GitHub stars in five days.
gh-90b953342bc0.headline_zh: ViralForge拆解短片並批量生成版本
gh-90b953342bc0.summary_zh: ViralForge（代理原生短片工作室）可一鍵仿製熱門短片，拆解開場鉤子與腳本，生成10個附成本估算的版本。配合Skill、MCP與CLI，創作者可由逐段拆解改稿變成批量製作。同類短片工具亦可看OpusClip。

gh-b62344349ca9.headline_en: MCP Lets Any AI App Design Orderable KiCad Boards
gh-b62344349ca9.summary_en: copper-kicad-mcp is an MCP server that lets AI apps design orderable KiCad boards, with schematics, LCSC parts, PCB routing, ERC/DRC checks, and JLCPCB fabrication files. Users can replace some manual drawing and file-preparation work with AI assistance; the project gained 102 GitHub stars in four days.
gh-b62344349ca9.headline_zh: KiCad MCP：AI 設計可下單 PCB
gh-b62344349ca9.summary_zh: copper-kicad-mcp 是讓 AI 應用操作開源電路設計軟件 KiCad 的 MCP 伺服器，可建立原理圖、選用 LCSC 元件、佈線、執行 ERC/DRC，並輸出 JLCPCB 製板檔。用戶以前要逐項手畫及整理生產檔，現在可由 AI 輔助完成可下單設計；專案四天獲 102 個 GitHub 星。不想整合 AI，也可直接手動使用 KiCad。

gh-a4b3e921cc42.headline_en: yasakani Targets Qwen3.8-27B Locally on One RTX 5090
gh-a4b3e921cc42.summary_en: yasakani is a local LLM engine for Windows, built to run Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090. For users, it offers a single-GPU route to run the model locally; the project gained 107 GitHub stars in four days (about 28 per day).
gh-a4b3e921cc42.summary_zh: yasakani 是 Windows 本地 LLM 引擎，可透過單張 NVIDIA RTX 5090 運行 Qwen3.8-27B。用戶毋須自行設定環境，可用單卡引擎；四天獲107個星標。同類可選 Ollama。

st-6c1d6a7dee13.summary_en: Claude's status page reports minor, partially degraded service. Check the status page before blaming your prompts, helping distinguish a temporary service issue from your input.
st-6c1d6a7dee13.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic 的 AI 對話助理）狀態頁顯示，服務出現「輕微、部分降級」。回應異常時可先查看狀態頁，毋須急於修改提示詞，有助分辨暫時服務問題與自身輸入；同類選擇有 ChatGPT、Gemini。

fd-b57fcdc61a2c.headline_en: llama.cpp adds four missing Jinja features
fd-b57fcdc61a2c.summary_en: The b12428 release adds four missing Jinja features and fixes an error message. Users can work with more template patterns and get clearer guidance when template handling fails.
fd-b57fcdc61a2c.headline_zh: llama.cpp 補強 Jinja 模板功能
fd-b57fcdc61a2c.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地大型語言模型推論工具）的 b12428 版本，新增 4 項欠缺的 Jinja 模板功能並修正錯誤訊息。過往部分模板寫法或無法支援，現可涵蓋更多用法，排查錯誤也更清楚；同類選擇有 Ollama。

fd-9a43fed6987c.headline_en: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea's AI Sector
fd-9a43fed6987c.summary_en: The two-day AI Day Seoul at COEX brought more than 2,000 industry leaders, startups, and developers together around physical AI and AI agents. Attendees could engage with all three groups in one place rather than seek out each community separately.
fd-9a43fed6987c.headline_zh: AI Day Seoul匯聚韓國AI社群
fd-9a43fed6987c.summary_zh: NVIDIA AI Day Seoul是兩日AI交流活動，超過2,000名產業領袖、科創公司及開發者聚首，聚焦實體AI與AI代理。與會者毋須分頭尋找資源，現可一次接觸韓國AI社群；同類選擇還有其他AI開發者大會。

st-4b7bc44c650e.summary_en: Claude's status page reported a minor service outage. Users experiencing unusual behavior can check the status page before assuming their prompts are at fault.
st-4b7bc44c650e.summary_zh: Claude（Anthropic推出的AI對話助手）狀態頁顯示服務曾出現輕微中斷。用戶若發現回答異常，可先查狀態頁，毋須立即重寫提示詞或懷疑自身操作；同類選擇亦可留意ChatGPT。

st-6f1190551db3.summary_en: DeepSeek, an AI model service, reported minor degraded performance in some components on its status page. Users can check the status page before blaming their prompts when they encounter service issues.
st-6f1190551db3.summary_zh: DeepSeek（AI模型服務）狀態頁顯示，部分組件出現「輕微」性能下降。用戶遇到服務異常時，可先查看狀態頁，判斷問題是否來自平台，而非提示詞本身；同類選擇是查閱其他 AI 服務狀態頁。

gh-55c0e107a307.headline_en: Repository tracks verified licenses and provenance for medical AI datasets
gh-55c0e107a307.summary_en: The mdexa-ai-native-database repository publishes verified license and provenance records for medical-AI datasets, including information cards, JSON Schema, decision rules, and a hash-only evidence index. It gives users a standardized way to check dataset source details instead of assembling those records manually.
gh-55c0e107a307.headline_zh: mdexa-ai 整理醫療AI資料授權與來源
gh-55c0e107a307.summary_zh: mdexa-ai 是整理醫療 AI 資料集授權與出處的資料庫，附資訊卡、JSON Schema、決策規則及只含雜湊值的證據索引。用戶過往要逐項搜資料，現可按統一結構核對，省下自行追查來源的時間；卡片採 CC BY 4.0、腳本採 MIT。同類文件可看 Hugging Face 資料卡。

gh-357efa56d377.headline_en: Gemini Config Checker finds proxy configurations for Google AI Studio and Gemini
gh-357efa56d377.summary_en: Gemini Config Checker is a GitHub utility that finds proxy configurations for accessing Google AI Studio and Gemini using a signed-in browser check, plus anti-DPI support on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android. It saves users from testing proxy chains one by one; dedicated proxy-testing tools are a similar alternative (the repository gained 474 GitHub stars in one day).
gh-357efa56d377.summary_zh: Gemini Config Checker 是 GitHub 代理檢查器，可找能連上 Google AI Studio、Gemini 的代理鏈，並做防 DPI 檢查。以前要逐項試，現在可檢查連線結果；同類可選代理測試器。

gh-0e5a531e152b.headline_en: Sophon enables local full-duplex voice AI
gh-0e5a531e152b.summary_en: Sophon is an open-source project for full-duplex voice models that can hear a speaker's tone and respond with speech. Users who relied on cloud voice APIs can now run it on one GPU or fully offline on a Mac, with zero-shot cloning and OpenAI Realtime / GPT-Live compatibility.
gh-0e5a531e152b.headline_zh: Sophon 開源全雙工語音模型
gh-0e5a531e152b.summary_zh: Sophon 係開源全雙工語音模型，可聆聽語氣並同時回話，支援零樣本聲音複製。依賴雲端語音 API 的用戶，現可改用單一 GPU 或 Mac 離線部署，兼容 OpenAI Realtime；同類選擇可看其他本地語音模型。

fd-1b62ef559289.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, released b12432 to avoid scanning every KV-cache cell when removing a sequence. This can reduce cleanup overhead for users managing concurrent inference workloads; another local-inference option is Ollama.
fd-1b62ef559289.headline_zh: llama.cpp 優化 KV-cache 清理
fd-1b62ef559289.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本機模型推論框架）發布 b12432，移除序列時避開 KV-cache cells 的線性掃描，降低清理開銷。用戶管理多個並行推論序列時，可減少逐格搜尋成本。同類選擇可看 Ollama。

fd-c68a52acebb4.headline_en: llama.cpp Returns 400 for Unsupported Reasoning Levels
fd-c68a52acebb4.summary_en: The b12431 llama.cpp server release rejects unsupported reasoning_effort levels with HTTP 400 instead of triggering HTTP 500 errors on the chat completions, responses, and messages endpoints. API clients can now distinguish an invalid setting from an internal server failure.
fd-c68a52acebb4.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正無效推理等級回應
fd-c68a52acebb4.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地AI推理軟件）更新後，模板不接受的 reasoning_effort 等級會回傳400，不再於伺服器端點變成500。用戶可分辨設定錯誤與伺服器故障；同類本地推理解法可選 Ollama。

fd-22a168cf2abb.summary_en: Workflow automation platform n8n released version 1.123.97 on November 16, 2026. The supplied notice lists no feature or fix details, so users would need the full release notes to judge the update’s practical impact.
fd-22a168cf2abb.summary_zh: 工作流程自動化平台 n8n 於2026年11月16日推出1.123.97版，但公布內容只包括版號與日期，未列新增功能或修正。用戶要判斷今次更新有否改善既有流程或操作體驗，仍須查看完整版本說明；同類選擇如 Zapier。

fd-af086867b5a6.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source local AI inference framework, released b12430 with a fix for a ggml-cuda regression affecting Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference on AMD's HIP platform. Users with affected setups can update to restore expected behavior, while CPU inference remains an option for systems without an AMD GPU.
fd-af086867b5a6.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修復 HIP MoE 回歸
fd-af086867b5a6.summary_zh: llama.cpp（開源本地 AI 推論框架）發布 b12430，修復 ggml-cuda 在 HIP 運行 MoE（混合專家模型）的回歸問題。過往異常推論現可恢復正常；沒有 AMD GPU，也可改用 CPU 推論。

fd-4ed9358d24f4.summary_en: vLLM, an open-source inference engine for large language models, released version 0.34.0. The announcement gives no feature or fix details, so users must consult the release notes to assess the upgrade.
fd-4ed9358d24f4.headline_zh: vLLM 發布 v0.34.0 新版本
fd-4ed9358d24f4.summary_zh: vLLM（開源大型語言模型推論引擎）發布 v0.34.0，用於部署及服務大型語言模型；惟公告未列明新功能或修正。用戶以往沿用舊版，現在可取得新版，惟實際效益仍待版本說明確認；同類選擇可留意模型推論框架。

fd-6c81c60c95d8.summary_en: llama.cpp, an open-source framework for running large language models locally, fixed incorrect NoPE metadata conversion for the Ripple dFlash2 model. Users converting that model can now obtain more accurate configuration files instead of carrying faulty metadata forward.
fd-6c81c60c95d8.headline_zh: llama.cpp 修正 Ripple 轉換錯誤
fd-6c81c60c95d8.summary_zh: llama.cpp（可在本機運行大型語言模型的開源框架）更新，修正 Ripple dFlash2 的 NoPE 中繼資料轉換。用戶轉換此模型時，不再會把錯誤設定帶入輸出，配置更準確；想另尋本地模型工具，也可比較 Ollama。
